lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I wanted to ask your opinion on something

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: that would be a bit difficult to discuss with anyone else.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's about the future of the Admire and the Aegis Squad.
Is this about money?
I don't have any money to lend to you.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You're as perceptive as always.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You're as perceptive as always. No surprise there.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: But you mustn't worry about that.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I wouldn't dream of asking you for money.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I wanted to talk to you about the donations that we're receiving.
Has less money been coming in?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: No, the amount of our patrons hasn't changed,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but it's just that with the recession nowadays,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: donations have taken a sharp decline.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Even the affluent citizens of the Ark

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: are hesitant to loosen their purse strings without good reason.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: But in order to maintain the Admire,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I have to keep money coming in.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: So, I was wondering

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: if you had any good methods where I could collect donations?
If you want me to lend you money, just ask.
What if you invest everything in a lottery?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's not that, truly.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It wouldn't feel right to take money from you.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: So gambling, essentially?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I can't do something dangerous like that
Then what about crowdfunding?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Crowdfunding?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: What's that?
It's a fundraising method using the internet.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Are you sure about this?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It sounds illegal to me.
It's 100% legal.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Can you explain in more detail?
All you have to do is make a website, then enter the reason why you're raising the money, and the amount required.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: And then what?
You just wait until you reach the target you set.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: That sounds much easier than I thought it'd be.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Still, I'm not familiar with any of this stuff.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Is it okay if I ask you to help me later on?
Absolutely. Call me anytime.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Thanks, Subordinate.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'm glad I came to you for advice.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'll come find you once our next fundraiser on the Admire ends.
Okay.
